# Suyash Bhattarai

> Suyash Bhattarai is an AI engineer and full stack developer. This portfolio covers LLM systems, model evaluation, search, routing, computer vision, and product engineering.

## Projects

- [Selected Work](https://www.suyashbhattarai.com.np/work): Browse Suyash Bhattarai's case studies and demos spanning LLM systems, evaluation tools, search, routing, computer vision, and full stack software.

- [Open Switch](https://www.suyashbhattarai.com.np/work-openswitch): Rust simulation of failure-aware routing with circuit breakers and hedged requests.

- [Screener](https://www.suyashbhattarai.com.np/work-screener): Rust hybrid paper search with keyword and semantic ranking.

- [Evalgate](https://www.suyashbhattarai.com.np/work-evalgate): Rust evaluation runner for recorded and live model outputs.

- [Quint](https://www.suyashbhattarai.com.np/work-quint): Deterministic choice-and-reveal library for React interfaces.

- [Entode](https://www.suyashbhattarai.com.np/work-entode): Compiler pipeline that turns an application spec into a verified backend.

## Case studies

- [Representation Alignment](https://www.suyashbhattarai.com.np/work-alignment): A case study on embedding alignment between independently trained toy encoders, including the reference reproduction and unsupervised experiments.

- [Entode](https://www.suyashbhattarai.com.np/work-entode): Entode translates a natural-language application spec into a backend through a reviewed compiler pipeline, verification steps, and independent tests.

- [Evalgate](https://www.suyashbhattarai.com.np/work-evalgate): Evalgate is a Rust evaluation runner for recorded and live model outputs, with weighted checks, regression reports, and a browser demo.

- [Flamide](https://www.suyashbhattarai.com.np/work-flamide): A case study of a multilingual AI agent for education consultancies, with code-enforced guardrails and database-level tenant isolation.

- [Corridor FX](https://www.suyashbhattarai.com.np/work-fx): Corridor FX is an operational dashboard that estimates currency exposure and forecasts risk bands for a remittance workflow on a managed peg.

- [Open Switch](https://www.suyashbhattarai.com.np/work-openswitch): Open Switch is a Rust routing simulator that tests failure-aware, latency-aware deployment selection with circuit breakers and hedged requests.

- [Quint](https://www.suyashbhattarai.com.np/work-quint): Quint is a deterministic choice-and-reveal React library for AI interfaces. This case study explains its input contracts, rendering, and demo.

- [Savings Score Stress Test](https://www.suyashbhattarai.com.np/work-savings-score): A synthetic stress test of a savings score for bars, with an audit of the headline findings, adoption assumptions, and sensitivity checks.

- [Screener](https://www.suyashbhattarai.com.np/work-screener): Screener is a Rust hybrid paper search engine using typo-tolerant BM25, static embeddings, and rank fusion, with a browser demo.

## Demos

- [Evalgate Browser Demo](https://www.suyashbhattarai.com.np/demo-evalgate): Try Evalgate in the browser with recorded model outputs, weighted evaluation checks, and a regression report generated by its Rust engine.

- [Corridor FX Demo](https://www.suyashbhattarai.com.np/demo-fx): Explore a browser-based USD to NPR forecast band and hedge calculator that shows how exchange-rate assumptions affect remittance exposure.

- [Open Switch Demo](https://www.suyashbhattarai.com.np/demo-openswitch): Run an interactive routing simulation to see latency, circuit breakers, failures, and hedged requests affect deployment selection.

- [Quint Live Demo](https://www.suyashbhattarai.com.np/demo-quint): Use the Quint demo to inspect each choice in a chat interface, including the model input, user-visible result, and render placement.

- [Screener Search Demo](https://www.suyashbhattarai.com.np/demo-screener): Search papers in the browser using keyword, semantic, and fused ranking, and compare how the Screener engine orders the results.
